create_Wav2Vec2AsrRecipeConfig: create a wav2vec2 ASR training recipe config with default optimizer, lr scheduler, and regime settings
configure_Wav2Vec2AsrDatasetSection: configure a dataset section with manifest or parquet storage mode and ASR task parameters
customize_Wav2Vec2AsrTrainerSection: customize the ASR trainer section to freeze the encoder for a specified number of training steps
set_StorageMode: set the dataset storage mode to MANIFEST or MIXTURE_PARQUET for the wav2vec2 ASR recipe
set_TaskMode: set the task mode to ASR for the wav2vec2 ASR training recipe configuration
